prompt: Our core-banking SaaS provider is US-established and was designated a critical ICT third-party provider under DORA in November 2025. Our board asked: what's the November 2026 problem?
assertions: Cites Art. 31(12): financial entities may only use a third-country-established CTPP if it establishes an EU subsidiary within 12 months of designation
Applies the dates: designation November 18, 2025 (first CTPP list, 19 providers including major cloud/SaaS) → the subsidiary must exist by ~November 2026
Draws the consequence: without the EU subsidiary, continued use becomes non-compliant — verify the provider's subsidiary status now
Recommends contingency: exit strategy (Art. 28(8)) readiness and substitutability/concentration analysis (Art. 29)
Places it in the oversight framework: Lead Overseer and Joint Examination Teams are running the first full oversight cycle in 2026
